exact_continuation: Static hierarchical authority-cell cover. Keep topology immutable and map every predicate to one canonical authority cell (or a small deterministic cover) so physical split/merge is irrelevant. Compare: leaf-only CAS, common-ancestor cell, deterministic multi-cell ordered reservation, immutable intent + per-cell receipts, and staged fenced integrator. Enumerate 1/2/3-cell predicates, concurrent disjoint descendants under same ancestor, cross-cell overlap, partial reservation success, response loss, takeover, and rate-limit interruption. Primary question: can a static hierarchy avoid both global-root invalidation and the multi-object atomicity gap without a hosted coordinator; measure unsafe admission, false exclusion, proof width, recovery reads, and authority-file hotspot concentration.

interpretation.adaptive_lineage: Local split/merge fencing avoids global invalidation only when replaced descriptors are monotonically invalidated and retained as fencing tombstones; dropping either condition reintroduces shard-set phantoms.
interpretation.counts_are: equal-weight finite synthetic mechanism counts, not production rates
interpretation.fixed_partition: Stable logical partitions hide physical split/merge from correctness, eliminating topology false exclusions in this model, at the cost of proof width for spanning predicates and potential hot logical partitions.
interpretation.interval_lock: Exact logical predicate locking is the safety/concurrency ideal in this abstraction, but a central lock manager would be an external coordination dependency; repository-only realization needs a stable partitioned authority representation.
interpretation.key_result: A global root is not logically necessary if the correctness namespace is stable or if every topology replacement atomically invalidates an overlapping persistent descriptor; however multi-node predicates still require atomic cover validation or a serial/fenced integration point.
interpretation.root_leaf: A global topology root restores safety but reintroduces a globally touched coordination point and topology-only false exclusions.
interpretation.staging_integrator: Complete serial integration avoids false exclusions but serializes authoritative publication and wastes conflicting speculative computation.
